BiblicalUsage: The word tᵉshîyʻîy carries the sense of ninth. In Leviticus 25:22, eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year, and it appears again in Numbers 7:60.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ninth still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
